integrity: An analytical proof and a reproducible finite numerical checker are provided. Classical gamma and Wiener results are explicitly credited. Independent verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Common positive real shape and two distinct positive rates; exact real-frequency zeros only, not complex zeros or arbitrary gamma mixtures. Relative lower bound rather than uniform absolute transform lower bound. Unexamined full text of Gharib (1995) remains a novelty risk.
title: A sharp Fourier noncancellation and translate-cyclicity phase diagram for two-scale gamma mixtures
